build_gemini_proxy_app: build a Ray Serve application that proxies OpenAI chat completions to Google Gemini API
create_chat_completion_endpoint: create a FastAPI endpoint at /v1/chat/completions that forwards requests to Gemini
transform_openai_messages_to_gemini: transform OpenAI-style chat messages into Google Gemini API format with system instructions
extract_gemini_model_version: extract the version number from a gemini model name string using regex
configure_gemini_reasoning_budget: configure thinking budget for Gemini 2.5+ reasoning models via the thinking_config parameter
